# 5 bedroom terraced house for sale

> A handsome and substantial five-bedroom period home positioned on the ever-popular Coniscliffe Road, offering an impressive blend of character features and versatile family living across three floors. Retaining much of its original charm, including tiled flooring, open fireplaces and generous proportions throughout, this elegant residence s ideal for modern family life.

## Fakta
- Typ: terraced house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 5 bedrooms
- Plocha: 199 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: E
- Lokalita: Coniscliffe Road, Darlington
- Cena: £350,000
